sheets.title: The phone's top bar — 390 × 844

sheets.after: menu 374×269 at x=8: inside the screen, every vault named beside its own glyph

sheets.title: Pressing the account glyph — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: Pressing the account glyph. The same menu opens; the profile is named beside its glyph.
sheets.before: menu 256×154 at x=78: entirely clipped, nothing is drawn
sheets.after: menu 374×154 at x=8: the profile named beside its glyph
